name: Anchor model with context and body fingerprints
description:
Location = path + line hint + optional symbol + span + context hash (normalized lines around start) + body hash (normalized span).
Normalization: trim, collapse whitespace, ignore blank lines, so reformatting is not drift.
Context hash answers 'where is it'; body hash answers 'did it change'. Lives in RepoCli.Core/Features/Anchors.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged df730c6. Hash = first 12 hex of SHA-256 over normalized lines (Fingerprint.HashLength). Context hash = 2 non-blank lines before + start line, so editing the first span line changes context too; #21 needs symbol/fuzzy fallback when the preceding lines change. Span counts non-blank lines; SourceText.EndLine gives the raw end. Anchor.Create snaps blank start lines to content (affects #22 legacy migration). Anchor serializes as flat primitives; register it in any JsonSerializerContext and skip null Symbol. No path:line+span text form yet; #22 to decide.
